div.div: غَنِجَةٌ (Bkh, S, A, MA, O, K) and ↓ مَغْنُوجَةٌ (A, MA) and [in an intensive sense] ↓ مِغْنَاجٌ , (O, K) applied to a girl, or young woman, (S, K,) or to a woman, (A, MA,) Using or who uses, amorous gesture or behaviour, &c., such as is termed غُنْج. (Bkh, S, A, MA, O, K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
